description: Narrow Runner Action capability injection and route Action workflow effects through completed task results.

tasks.title: Implement capability-gated Action execution
tasks.spec: specs/action-capabilities/spec.md#Action manifests declare non-default capabilities; specs/action-result-effects/spec.md#Capability-gated Action results request workflow effects
tasks.description: Make manifest capabilities and input rendering timing the Runner's executable Action boundary, replace broad Action contexts with validated inputs plus a narrow host, and migrate every built-in Action in the same switchover. Move OpenCode runtime/session and parent-Issue handling behind agent-turn, Issue content behind issue-fields, archive retry identity behind workflow-checkpoint, and raw OpenSpec task defaults into a deferred manifest input; then route authorized Action effects through the executor result pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Manifests validate the closed agent-turn, issue-fields, workflow-checkpoint, add-tasks, and write-vars capability set; an Action receives only the default host and its declared capabilities, with no server, runtime, variables, recovery, or dispatch metadata exposure.

mohist/opencode preserves its parent-Issue prompt composition, turn/session behavior, public output, and business errors while agent-turn capability declaration, not an Action-name list, controls private turn-fact completion projection.

Issue-field consumers obtain title/body through issue-fields and archive checkpointing obtains an opaque workflow-checkpoint token; neither host capability exposes dispatch identity, and existing input/output/error contracts remain unchanged.

Result normalization rejects malformed or unauthorized effects with unexpected-error; checks cannot silently apply effects; Action effects never enter public output, recovery matching, captured outputs, or artifacts.

mohist/openspec-tasks receives its manifest-declared deferred task input without a rawTask field or Action-name branch, preserves nested templates for generated-task dispatch, and reports generated follow-up tasks through the completed task result; failed completion or executor postconditions suppress task additions.

Authorized variable effects and declarative setVars are applied through one Run Variables patch after postconditions, with setVars taking precedence on conflicts; a patch failure fails the task and suppresses additions.

Focused Runner unit/spec coverage exercises manifest capability and deferred-input validation, host visibility, opaque context capabilities, agent-turn projection, unauthorized effects, deferred OpenSpec templates and additions, variable patch precedence and failure, and preserved OpenSpec behavior using fakes only.
npm run typecheck -w packages/runner and npm test -w packages/runner pass.
tasks.output: Capability-gated Runner Action host, result-effect pipeline, migrated built-in Actions, and focused regression coverage under packages/runner/.
tasks.notes: All Action call sites must switch atomically because retaining the old ActionContext overload would preserve the forbidden capability surface. The migration must replace both executor Action-name branches: promise projection and openspec-tasks rawTask injection. This task covers every requirement in both capability specs and design decisions 1-7.
